facts.name: Avalon at Mission Bay
facts.specials: Explore our newly renovated homes with new upgraded features and appliances.
facts.utilities: Included with Furnished+ homes; otherwise, not included in quoted rent and may be extra.
facts.pet_policy: Cats and dogs are welcome. Check dog breed and pet restrictions.
facts.lease_terms: Flexible lease terms, including terms as short as 30 days for Furnished+ homes. Specific units show 20 or 21 month leases. Pricing may vary based on lease term.
facts.notes: Avalon at Mission Bay offers studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments and townhomes. Furnished+ program available with flexible lease terms and included utilities. Located in SoMa, near Oracle Park and Chase Center. On-site retail includes Chase Bank and Bark Avenue Doggy Daycare. Affordable housing program available for qualifying residents. Features CONNECT+ smart home, BILT Rewards, AVALONFIT wellness, and AVALONACCESS resident portal.
